values.name: max grid cells rendered at once
values.source: app.js MAX_CELLS = 4096; viewList() slices the list to this cap and shows a narrowing note

values.name: default grid cell size
values.source: app.js state.cell = 160 initial value

values.name: minimum grid cell size
values.source: app.js zoom-out click handler: state.cell = Math.max(72, state.cell - 20)

values.name: maximum grid cell size
values.source: app.js zoom-in click handler: state.cell = Math.min(320, state.cell + 20)

values.name: zoom step per click
values.source: app.js zoom in/out handlers: +/- 20 px per click

values.name: All-view window width
values.source: app.js viewList: var size = 0x400; // 1024 — the All view lists a 1024-codepoint window centred on state.anchor

values.name: Unicode planes tabbed (P0..P16 plus All)
values.source: app.js PLANES array (Latin-1, Latin Extended, IPA/CJK, CJK Unified, Pictographs, Math, Supplemental, Symbolic, Private Use, Pua-A, Pua-B, Compatibility, Symbols, Suppl. Symbols, Tangut*, Pua-C) + All

values.name: sample font unitsPerEm (PeptasiaIconFont.otf)
values.source: Peptasia head table, read by app/font.js FontParser.load; verified ok:true, 0 errors (933 glyphs)

values.name: sample font glyph count (PeptasiaIconFont)
values.source: Peptasia maxp table via font.js FontParser.load (933 glyphs; glyph 0 is .notdef)

values.name: sample font defined codepoints (PeptasiaIconFont)
values.source: Peptasia cmap via the validated secondary reader (font.js falls back to vendored opentype.js when the hand format-4 cmap self-check fails); 930 icons in the Private Use Area plus U+0020 space

values.name: fallback unitsPerEm when a font lacks one
values.source: app.js: var upem = (f && f.unitsPerEm) || 1000 (inspector and export both use this fallback)

values.name: cmap self-check threshold (secondary reader fallback)
values.value: a cmap is rejected when the same glyph id is mapped by more than one codepoint; font.js then uses the vendored opentype.js cmap (f.cmap2) and its CFF glyph names (f.ot2). Peptasia triggers this.
values.source: app/font.js load(): cmapResolver + seen[] duplicate-gid scan -> f.warnings 'using the secondary reader for this table'

values.name: big-view glyph draw scale
values.value: dynamic: s = (min(cssW,cssH) − 2·pad) / max(inkW, inkH), pad = 5% of min side; the ink box is measured by rendering the character offscreen with the same registered font as the grid cells (inkBox helper), so the big view is the small cell scaled up
values.source: app.js drawBigGlyph: var s = (Math.min(cssW, cssH) - 2 * pad) / Math.max(spanX, spanY), spanX/spanY from inkBox(cp, upem, adv)

values.name: big-view baseline position
values.value: dynamic: originX = cssW/2 − s·inkCx, baselineY = cssH/2 + s·inkCy — the measured ink centre is placed at the panel centre (textAlign left so the pen origin lands exactly there; 'center' would undo the measured offset). Verified on the real canvas buffer: ink-centre offset ≤ 0.8% of panel
values.source: app.js drawBigGlyph: var originX = cssW / 2 - s * gx_c; var baselineY = cssH / 2 + s * gy_c (gx_c/gy_c = ink box centre in font units, y-up)

values.name: big-view metric guides
values.value: none — em box, baseline bar and advance guide removed per user request; the panel shows only the rendered glyph, same as the grid cells; metrics remain in the details pane (name, gid, advance, bbox)
values.source: app.js drawBigGlyph: no em-box strokeRect / baseline / advance drawing; details pane m-name / m-gid / m-adv / m-bbox

values.name: PNG export glyph scale
values.source: app.js exportPNG: var scale = 1024 / (data.upem || 1000); // 1 em -> ~1024 px

values.name: SVG export path coordinate precision
values.source: app.js exportSVG: opentype charToGlyph(cp).getPath(0, 0, upem).toPathData(3)

values.name: export glyph resolution
values.value: by codepoint via vendored opentype.js charToGlyph(cp); on Peptasia (corrupt hand cmap) it is the only correct read — U+E001 -> gid 30 'uniE001', U+E005 -> gid 762 'uniE005'
values.source: app.js export path + lib/opentype.min.js (vendored opentype.js, MIT, self-contained, no network)

values.name: SVG raster fallback when outline undecodable
values.source: app.js: corrupt cmap / WOFF without zlib / .notdef embeds the browser's own hi-res render as a base64 <image> inside the SVG; toast reports vector or raster

values.name: viewer rendering engine
values.value: browser FontFace + canvas engine; the hand glyf/CFF decoders in font.js are never used for drawing
values.source: app.js registerFont() builds a FontFace and every grid cell and the big view hand the codepoint to the browser font engine

values.name: toast duration
values.source: app.js toast(): toastTimer = setTimeout(..., 3200)

values.name: theme modes
values.value: light (default) and dark; toggle in the top bar (id=theme-toggle), persisted to localStorage key "gfv-theme", applied pre-paint by an inline <script> in index.html to avoid a flash
values.source: index.html head inline script + app.js setTheme()/state.theme; CSS [data-theme="dark"] block in style.css

values.name: dark background colour (--bg)
values.source: style.css [data-theme="dark"] --bg; panel is --panel #1a1d25, glyph ink --ink #e6e9f0 (white glyphs on dark)

values.name: inspector canvas ink
values.value: glyph fill = Fill picker, outline = Outline picker + thickness slider, all read from exportColors() at draw time — the same values the export uses (WYSIWYG); default pickers track the theme --ink until edited; 'No glyph' text = --ink-rgb
values.source: app.js drawBigGlyph: var col = exportColors(); ctx.fillStyle = col.fill; optional strokeText/fill with col.stroke/col.width; picker input handlers call renderInspector()

values.name: export colour pickers follow theme
values.source: app.js setTheme(): until the user edits them (state.colorsTouched) the color-fill/color-stroke inputs are reset to the theme --ink, so a default export is white on dark; editing freezes them

values.name: live colour preview (WYSIWYG)
values.source: app.js drawBigGlyph() reads exportColors() and applies fill + outline + thickness to the on-screen glyph; the picker/thickness input handlers call renderInspector(), so every change is visible in the big view immediately, not only in the export

values.name: OS/2 metric table offsets (fixed)
values.value: sTypoAscender@68, sTypoDescender@70, sTypoLineGap@72, usWinAscent@74, usWinDescent@76, sXHeight@78, sCapHeight@80 (an earlier revision read them at 52/54/56/72/74, 16 bytes early, and silently returned 0)
values.source: font.js parseOS2(r, base, len); verified against PeptasiaIconFont.otf OS/2 (ascent 750, descent -250, win 1000/0)

values.name: SVG font support (legacy <font>/<glyph> XML)
values.source: app.js addFont() guard: browsers removed SVG fonts from the CSS Font API, so they cannot be registered for rendering; a .svg upload shows an explanatory note

values.name: sample fonts auto-loaded at startup
values.source: app.js loadSamples(): only sample/PeptasiaIconFont.otf is fetched and added; it is the default selection when no persisted font is restored (boot -> loadSamples(defaultFocus))

values.name: uploaded fonts persist across restarts (file system)
values.source: app.js savePersistedFont()/loadPersistedFonts(): when served by server.js (Docker) or the native host, uploads are POSTed to /api/fonts and written to data/fonts/ (a mounted volume keeps them across container restarts); with no server they fall back to browser IndexedDB. Deduplicated by bufSig() length+FNV-1a content signature
